supplements.name: react-remove-scroll-bar
supplements.evidence: License text is sourced from the 2.3.7 upstream LICENSE at pinned commit 8ca9ba5ea52de03308fe8ced94f7b159a44d28ff. Registry-SRI-verified npm tarballs for 2.3.7 and 2.3.8 each contain 27 files; 26 files, including all shipped source/declarations and README, are byte-identical. The sole changed file is package/package.json, whose only differences are the version and react-style-singleton dependency range. Both registry records identify MIT and the same author; the identical README contains a MIT License section. Association of the 2.3.7 notice with published 2.3.8 is inferred from this tarball content identity. The registry-declared 2.3.8 gitHead remains unverified against public upstream history, and this evidence does not establish legal ownership or authorization.
